summary.headline: Hephaestion Chapters and Codex Comparisons
summary.text: Discussion of chapters 26–243 from Hephaestion of Thebes and other ancient astrologers, comparing their contents and folio locations with Florentine codex 7. Topics include the twelve parts and their powers, zodiac signs, divisions of time, active days and hours, rulers and potentates, and mutual rulership, with Julianus, Syrus, Antiochus, and Nechepso named.
